Pune: Swargate-Katraj Metro Extension: Tunnelling To Begin in January As First TBM Arrives

Pune, 4th November 2026: Work on the underground extension of the Pimpri Chinchwad-Swargate Metro corridor to Katraj is expected to begin in January, with the first of the four tunnel boring machines (TBMs) required for the project arriving in Pune.

The Swargate-Katraj tunnelling is expected to begin in January once the launching shaft at Swargate is ready.
